entries.subject: Five open items carried from the B1-3 contract
entries.text:
Parked overnight; none blocks writing code, but three change what the code must do, so implementation is held until you decide.

1. Flyway version allocation across concurrent B1 movements. Same question as relay NXS-LOCAL-0103 item 2; it now blocks two movements. Proposal: you allocate the next version at dispatch and it is recorded in the packet.

2. DIRECTORY-POSTURE operational ceiling. C3 section 9 item 1 leaves this to you as a deployment decision. It affects how strict the adapter is allowed to be.

3. SR-D10 fingerprint attributability. C3 section 9 item 5 is open. This movement adopts the existing algorithm unchanged rather than deciding it.

4. M14 U-1 nested group membership. C3 section 9 item 6 is blocked on vendor documentation. The contract assumes flat membership until you say otherwise.

5. Numeric defaults proposed by the contract: idle timeout, absolute session lifetime, re-validation interval, throttles and connection pool sizing. These are tunable and not load bearing; confirm or replace them.

entries.text:
Every question parked on this relay is answered in docs/design/UI2_0_B1_ADJUDICATION_2026_09_12.md section 2, and the twelve cross-contract findings that an adversarial review raised are adjudicated in its section 1. This movement's contract is FROZEN as of 2026-09-12 and is read as amended by that document.

Three of those findings were gaps no contract owned: nobody created the job lifecycle objects the executor reads, the gate registry storage was assigned in a circle, and nobody set the audit context that the schema fails closed without. Implementing any of these movements before the adjudication would have failed at runtime.

The implementation order is fixed in section 3 of the adjudication: B1-2, then B1-3, then B1-4b, then B1-4. B1-2 may not run concurrently with any of the others because the Flyway version ledger is a single global sequence. Version numbers are allocated: B1-2 is V1, B1-3 is V2, B1-4b is V3, B1-4 is V4.
